name: JK Chikan Densha ~Tsuugakuchuu no Shojo, Sawarimasen ka?~
original_name: JK痴漢電車 ～通学中の処女、さわりませんか？～
source:
The protagonist is Yamazaki Shizuka, a worn-out salaryman working at a mid-sized company.  

At one point in his life, he was the school hero—top of his class, excelling in sports.  
But during his university entrance exams, he mixed up his answer sheets and failed spectacularly.  
Around the same time, his father was laid off, leaving Shizuka unable to retake the exams. He ended up at a safety-net university on a scholarship.  
His college years were far from what he’d hoped for, and he grew cynical. Job hunting went poorly, and the company he finally landed a job at let him go without a second thought. Since then, it’s been a cycle of job-hopping.  

His only solace is attending concerts of a popular idol group.  
Watching them shine on stage, he often mutters to himself,  
“Alright, starting next week, I’ll get serious, divorce my wife, and marry one of them.”  

One day, during his commute, he spots a high school girl studying English on the train.  
“I used to memorize vocabulary like that on the train too,” he thinks, feeling nostalgic.  
As he gets closer, he catches the sweet, unmistakable scent of a high school girl…  
Taking advantage of the train’s sway, he casually brushes against her lower body.  
Whether she doesn’t notice or is too focused on her studies, she doesn’t react.  

“Huh, maybe it’s okay to touch her after all.”  
And with that, the protagonist’s descent begins.  

“Listen, associating words with sensations helps you remember them better. You’ll memorize even the toughest vocabulary if I touch you like this.”  

Thus begins the protagonist’s perverted “English lesson”!

translation:
主人公山崎静是一名疲惫不堪的公司职员，就职于一家中型企业。

他也曾是学校里的风云人物——成绩名列前茅，运动同样出众。
可参加大学入学考试时，他把答题卡弄混，最终一败涂地。
几乎就在同一时期，父亲遭到裁员，静再也无力复读。他只能依靠奖学金进入一所保底大学。
大学生活与理想相去甚远，他也渐渐变得愤世嫉俗。求职过程并不顺利，好不容易进入的公司又毫不犹豫地将他解雇。此后，他便不断辗转于一份又一份工作之间。

他唯一的慰藉，是前去观看某个人气偶像团体的演唱会。
看着她们在舞台上闪闪发光，他经常自言自语：
“好，从下周开始我就认真起来，和老婆离婚，再娶她们中的一个。”

某天上班途中，他看见一名女高中生在电车里学习英语。
“我以前也会在电车上这样背单词呢。”他怀念地想着。
靠近之后，他闻到了女高中生身上那股甜美而独特的气味……
他借着车厢摇晃，若无其事地擦过少女的下身。
不知少女是没有察觉，还是太专注于学习，她毫无反应。

“咦，看来摸摸她也没关系嘛。”
主人公就此开始向深渊坠落。

“听好了，把单词和感觉联系起来会更容易记忆。只要我像这样摸你，再难的词也能背下来。”

主人公变态的“英语课”就此开讲！
